consequence.statement: Deferred creation of a subset of Envoy stats is enabled by default as an experimental feature. It saves memory and CPU, and can be disabled by setting ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION to false.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds an experimental feature that lazily creates a subset of Envoy statistics, and it can be disabled by setting the ENABLE_DEFERRED_STATS_CREATION environment variable to false in the agent Deployment.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The text does not say which environments are exposed. It describes a new experimental feature with an opt-out, and the evidence states no failure.
